semantics.structure: Two intermediate wires driven by the two AND gates; out driven by the OR gate and feeding the inverter.
semantics.timing: Combinational gates as described in original problem; no clock, state, reset, or cycle latency.
semantics.initialization: No stored state or specified initialization; outputs follow gate operations after combinational settling.

numeric.width: All ports and intermediate wires are one bit.
numeric.operators: Bitwise AND, OR, and NOT with Verilog four-state gate semantics.

verification.oracle: Independent truth table: out is true exactly when a and b are both 1 or c and d are both 1; out_n is complementary.
verification.cases: All 16 binary inputs plus directed unknown/high-impedance propagation and masking cases.
verification.sampling: Sample 1 ns after driving each input tuple to allow combinational settling.
verification.completion: Fatal on any mismatch, bounded timeout, and PASS only after all checks.
